crossRefs.note: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who…
that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and…
But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be…
“Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.
And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a…
bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you…

translations.web: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’
translations.bsb: Shouldn’t you have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had on you?’
translations.kjv: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
translations.asv: shouldest not thou also have had mercy on thy fellow-servant, even as I had mercy on thee?
